in_sanskrit.name: शोर्या
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: शक्तिः (shaktiḥ) - power, ability; बल: (balam) - strength. So Shorya in Sanskrit means 'Powerful, Strong'.

in_hindi.name: शोर्या
in_hindi.long_meaning: शक्ति (shakti) - power, ability; बल (bal) - strength. So Shorya in Hindi also means 'Powerful, Strong'.

in_tamil.name: சோர்யா
in_tamil.long_meaning: பவன் (pavaṉ) - lord, master; அருகியல் (arugiyal) - powerful, strong. So Shorya in Tamil means 'Lord of Power, Master of Strength'.

in_telugu.name: శోర్యా
in_telugu.long_meaning: శక్తి (śakti) - power, ability; బల (balam) - strength. So Shorya in Telugu also means 'Powerful, Strong'.

in_marathi.name: Shorya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Victory
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shorya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। God who brings victory in battles and in life

in_bengali.name: Shorya
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Victory
in_bengali.long_meaning: Shorya একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। God who brings victory in battles and in life
